## Collect all Table 1 for all imputed dataset
```{r}
# Table 1 for the overall population in each imputed dataset
tb1_list <- map(
  imputed_data,
  ~ CreateTableOne(
    vars = extended_covariates,
    data = .x,
    factorVars = categorical_vars,
    includeNA = TRUE,
    test = TRUE
  )
)

# Table 1 by lung cancer status in each imputed dataset
tb2_list <- map(
  imputed_data,
  ~ CreateTableOne(
    vars = extended_covariates,
    strata = "lungc_status_coxph",
    data = .x,
    factorVars = categorical_vars,
    includeNA = TRUE,
    test = TRUE
  )
)

tb1_list
tb2_list

```

## Continuous variables - Table 1 for taking the average of the 10 imputed datasets
```{r}
# Extract the mean, sd, n for continuous variables from each imputed dataset 
cont_summary_each_imp <- imap_dfr(
  imputed_data,
  function(dat, imp_name) {
    map_dfr(
      continuous_vars,
      function(v) {
        dat %>%
          summarise(
            imputed_dataset = imp_name,
            variable = v,
            mean = mean(.data[[v]], na.rm = TRUE),
            sd = sd(.data[[v]], na.rm = TRUE),
            n = sum(!is.na(.data[[v]])),
            .groups = "drop"
        )
      }
    )
  }
)

# Take the average of the mean, sd, n range across 10 imputed datasets
cont_table1_avg <- cont_summary_each_imp %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_avg = mean(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_avg = mean(sd, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_min = min(n, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_max = max(n, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_sd = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean_avg, sd_avg),
    n_range = paste0(n_min, "-", n_max)
  )

cont_table1_avg

# Extract the mean, sd, n for continuous variables by lung cancer status from each imputed dataset 
cont_summary_each_imp_lungc <- imap_dfr(
  imputed_data,
  function(dat, imp_name) {
    
    map_dfr(
      continuous_vars,
      function(v) {
        
        dat %>%
          group_by(lungc_status_coxph) %>%
          summarise(
            imputed_dataset = imp_name,
            variable = v,
            mean = mean(.data[[v]], na.rm = TRUE),
            sd = sd(.data[[v]], na.rm = TRUE),
            n = sum(!is.na(.data[[v]])),
            .groups = "drop"
          )
      }
    )
  }
)

# Take the average of the mean, sd, n range by lung cancer status across 10 imputed datasets
cont_table1_avg_lungc <- cont_summary_each_imp_lungc %>%
  group_by(variable, lungc_status_coxph) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_avg = mean(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_avg = mean(sd, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_min = min(n, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_max = max(n, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_sd = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean_avg, sd_avg),
    n_range = paste0(n_min, "-", n_max)
  )

cont_table1_avg_lungc

```

## Categorical variables - Table 1 for taking the average of the 10 imputed datasets
```{r}
# Extract the count and percentage for categorical variables from each imputed dataset 
categorical_summary_each_imp <- imap_dfr(
  imputed_data,
  function(dat, imp_name) {
    
    map_dfr(
      categorical_vars,
      function(v) {
        
        dat %>%
          filter(!is.na(.data[[v]])) %>%
          count(level = .data[[v]], name = "count") %>%
          mutate(
            imputed_dataset = imp_name,
            variable = v,
            pct = 100 * count / sum(count)
          ) %>%
          select(
            imputed_dataset,
            variable,
            level,
            count,
            pct
          )
      }
    )
  }
)

# Take the average of the count and pct across 10 imputed datasets
categorical_table1_avg <- categorical_summary_each_imp %>%
  group_by(variable, level) %>%
  summarise(
    count_avg = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_avg = mean(pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_pct = sprintf("%.0f (%.2f)", count_avg, pct_avg)
  )

categorical_table1_avg

# Extract the count and percentage for categorical variables from each imputed dataset 
categorical_summary_each_imp_lungc <- imap_dfr(
  imputed_data,
  function(dat, imp_name) {
    
    map_dfr(
      categorical_vars,
      function(v) {
        
        dat %>%
          group_by(lungc_status_coxph) %>%
          filter(!is.na(.data[[v]])) %>%
          count(level = .data[[v]], name = "count") %>%
          mutate(
            imputed_dataset = imp_name,
            variable = v,
            pct = 100 * count / sum(count)
          ) %>%
          select(
            imputed_dataset,
            lungc_status_coxph,
            variable,
            level,
            count,
            pct
          )
      }
    )
  }
)

# Take the average of the count and pct by lung cancer status across 10 imputed datasets
categorical_table1_avg_lungc <- categorical_summary_each_imp_lungc %>%
  group_by(variable, lungc_status_coxph, level) %>%
  summarise(
    count_avg = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_avg = mean(pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_pct = sprintf("%.0f (%.2f)", count_avg, pct_avg)
  )

categorical_table1_avg_lungc

```

## For MET, we use median and IQR instead
```{r}
summed_MET_minutes_weekly_imputed <- c("summed_MET_minutes_weekly_imputed")

met_each_imp <- imap_dfr(
  imputed_data,
  function(dat, imp_name) {
    map_dfr(
      summed_MET_minutes_weekly_imputed,
      function(v) {
        dat %>%
          summarise(
            imputed_dataset = imp_name,
            variable = v,
            median = median(.data[[v]], na.rm = TRUE),
            q1 = quantile(.data[[v]], probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
            q3 = quantile(.data[[v]], probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = sum(!is.na(.data[[v]])),
            .groups = "drop"
          ) %>%
  mutate(
    median_iqr = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", median, q1, q3)      
    )
      }
    )
  }
)

met_each_imp

# Take the average of median and IQR across all datasets
met_pooled <- met_each_imp %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(
    median = mean(median, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1 = mean(q1, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3 = mean(q3, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    median_iqr = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", median, q1, q3)      
    )
  
met_pooled

# Extract the median and IQR by lung cancer status for MET from each dataset 
met_each_imp_lungc <- imap_dfr(
  imputed_data,
  function(dat, imp_name) {
    
    map_dfr(
      summed_MET_minutes_weekly_imputed,
      function(v) {
        
        dat %>%
          group_by(lungc_status_coxph) %>%
          summarise(
            imputed_dataset = imp_name,
            variable = v,
            median = median(.data[[v]], na.rm = TRUE),
            q1 = quantile(.data[[v]], probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
            q3 = quantile(.data[[v]], probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = sum(!is.na(.data[[v]])),
            .groups = "drop"
          ) %>%
  mutate(
    median_iqr = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", median, q1, q3) )
      }
    )
  }
)

met_each_imp_lungc

# Take the average of median and IQR by lung cancer status across all datasets
met_pooled_lungc <- met_each_imp_lungc %>%
  group_by(variable, lungc_status_coxph) %>%
  summarise(
    median = mean(median, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1 = mean(q1, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3 = mean(q3, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    median_iqr = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", median, q1, q3)      
    
  )

met_pooled_lungc
```

## Table 1 for complete-case analysis
```{r}
# Load the coxph_data_complete_case and use extended_covariates_original
extended_covariates_original <- c(
  "age",
  "sex",
  "ethnicity_UKB",
  "education_ISCED",
  "tdi",
  "bmi",
  "waist_to_hip",
  "smk_status",
  "pack_year",
  "family_lc",
  "lung_disease_history",
  "lipid_lowering_meds",
  "Summed_MET_minutes_weekly",
  "fasting_time",
  "centre_group"
)

tb3 <- CreateTableOne(vars = extended_covariates_original,strata = "lungc_status_coxph", data = coxph_data_complete_case, factorVars=categorical_vars, includeNA = TRUE, test = TRUE)
print(tb3, catDigits=2, contDigits=2)
tb4 <- CreateTableOne(vars = extended_covariates_original, data = coxph_data_complete_case, factorVars=categorical_vars, includeNA = TRUE)
print(tb4, catDigits=2, contDigits=2)
```
